deterministic_issue.description: The unexecuted implementation verified the frozen official-roster file and loaded the optional frozen global audit projection only after invoking the real Week 2 player parser. A missing, corrupt, or schema-drifted immutable dependency could therefore cross the player-target empirical boundary and terminate before a canonical cohort receipt was frozen. This was identified by static code review before any workflow run or Week 2 player observation.

frozen_hardening.official_roster_dependency_validation: must complete before the selected real Week 2 article is passed to the player-level parser
frozen_hardening.global_audit_projection_validation: must complete before the selected real Week 2 article is passed to the player-level parser
frozen_hardening.playwright_import_validation: must complete before the selected real Week 2 article is passed to the player-level parser
frozen_hardening.dependency_failure_before_player_parse: PRE_TARGET_TECHNICAL_FAIL with zero target exposure; no NGS request
